identification: Modern (probably 1960s-90s) yellow gold Southern Cross constellation brooch: long vertical bar crossed by a horizontal bar plus a short diagonal arm to Epsilon Crucis, five five-point star cups each holding a white cultured pearl (about 4-5 mm). Measured off the tape at about 55 mm high by 43 mm wide (cloud scan said 60 mm). Bars are fine square wire, so light. Catalogue says 14K. Lot page: estimate A$300-400, no current bid value showing (27 Nov ~20:10).

viewing_check: Read the back: 14K/585 (or 9ct/375, or GF/rolled gold); maker or Broome jeweller mark (Paspaley, Linneys, Kailis would add value). Weigh it (max assumes about 3.5 g). Check pearls are cultured (gritty on teeth), none chipped or loose, and pin/catch are gold and work.
